name: 账单进口
tagline: Files WeChat and Alipay statements into a personal ledger, with a preview first
description: Chinese payment apps export a month of activity as a spreadsheet, and plenty of people only have a screenshot. This one reads either, sorts each line into a category, drops the duplicates that come from overlapping exports, and shows you the result before a single row is saved. It never asks for a password.
author: coolbat1999
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
